cases.name: default
cases.note: First empty-process test — StartEvent (webhook) → EndEvent (Set). Two typed fields (`testnumber`: number, `teststring`: string) flow through from the payload. Note the payload keys are lowercase to match SBPA's canonical property names — SBPA's schema.title preserves camelCase for display but the emitted formula reads the lowercased key. Before this was strengthened with expectResult, the old fixture posted camelCased keys that didn't match the formula and produced { testnumber: null, teststring: null } output — passing silently because execution.status was `success` regardless.
